name: Get Cell
description: Read one cell by address from an opened workbook — a total, a date, a name — as a plain value (a formula cell answers its computed result).

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const ws = workbook.getWorksheet(sheet); if (!ws) return undefined; const plain = (v) => v && typeof v === 'object' ? ('result' in v ? v.result : Array.isArray(v.richText) ? v.richText.map((t) => t.text).join('') : 'text' in v ? v.text : v) : v; return plain(ws.getCell(String(address)).value); })() }}"}]
